mapper.select: SELECT id, year, name, start_date, end_date, is_current FROM seasons WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND is_current = TRUE ORDER BY year DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, year, name, start_date, end_date, is_current FROM seasons WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND year = #{seasonYear} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, year, name, start_date, end_date, is_current FROM seasons WHERE team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY year DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS games, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS wins, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS losses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.result = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS draws, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(g.runs_for, 0)), 0)::INTEGER AS runs_for, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(g.runs_against, 0)), 0)::INTEGER AS runs_against FROM games g WHERE g.season_id = #{seasonId} AND g.status = 'completed' AND g.result IN ('win', 'loss', 'draw')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS INTEGER) AS games, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS wins, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS losses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.result = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS draws, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(g.runs_for, 0)), 0)::INTEGER AS runs_for, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(g.runs_against, 0)), 0)::INTEGER AS runs_against FROM games g JOIN seasons s ON s.id = g.season_id WHERE s.team_id = #{teamId} AND g.status = 'completed' AND g.result IN ('win', 'loss', 'draw')

SELECT g.id AS game_id, g.game_date, g.start_time, g.opponent_name, g.status, g.result, g.runs_for, g.runs_against, g.tournament_id, t.name AS tournament_name, g.stadium_id, st.name AS stadium_name, g.venue_name FROM games g LEFT JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = g.tournament_id LEFT JOIN stadiums st ON st.id = g.stadium_id WHERE g.season_id = #{seasonId} AND g.status = 'completed' AND g.result IN ('win', 'loss', 'draw', 'no_game') ORDER BY g.game_date DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.id AS game_id, g.game_date, g.start_time, g.opponent_name, g.status, g.result, g.runs_for, g.runs_against, g.tournament_id, t.name AS tournament_name, g.stadium_id, st.name AS stadium_name, g.venue_name FROM games g LEFT JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = g.tournament_id LEFT JOIN stadiums st ON st.id = g.stadium_id WHERE g.season_id = #{seasonId} AND g.status = 'scheduled' ORDER BY g.game_date ASC, g.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
